g.text: TrialWatch — AI architecture decisions & learning map

21 decisions every production AI system has to make, each tied to a real TrialWatch case and one small lab. Tags map to the Claude Certified Architect exams. Order of work: adr-roadmap.excalidraw. As of 2026-11-22.
Lanes run top → bottom in the order you would build
a system. Each card is one architect decision:
the real case in this project

Each rung to the right: more flexible, less predictable, harder to test, more expensive.
Climb one rung only when the rung below fails your evals. Most production value sits on rungs 1–3.
